answer: An economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by enforcing a computational cost-of-minting requirement. To generate a fake agent identity, an attacker must perform real CPU work, pushing their resource expenditure to the zenith of exhaustion. The forged identity, like a sable hiding in the dark, cannot persist without draining the attacker's computational budget, and like a lotus blooming in shadow, it demands an unsustainable toll for its creation.
